# AI Hacker News

> AI Hacker News (https://aihackernews.github.io/) is an independent news
> front page covering only artificial intelligence: new models, research,
> startups, funding, policy and tools. Stories are gathered from across
> the web every few hours, checked for freshness (last 7 days), and
> de-duplicated. It is not affiliated with Y Combinator or Hacker News.

The front page is a single HTML page whose newest stories are also
prerendered into the HTML itself, so no JavaScript is needed to read the
current headlines. The full dataset is public JSON (see below).

## Key pages

- [Front page](https://aihackernews.github.io/): the latest AI news, newest first
- [Submit a story](https://aihackernews.github.io/submit.html): how readers submit news (via GitHub issues with a [NEW_POST] title prefix)

## Machine-readable data

- [Latest stories (JSON)](https://aihackernews.github.io/latest.json): the current news bundle — `{"records": [...], "link": "<archive file or null>"}`. Each record has `title`, `url`, `source`, `summary`, `published_at` (ISO 8601 UTC), `tags`, and sometimes `submitted_by` (the GitHub user credited with a community submission). Follow `link` to older archive bundles (`archive_{YYYYMMDD}_{random4}.json`, same format) for history; `latest.json` holds at most 1000 records.
- [Sitemap](https://aihackernews.github.io/sitemap.xml): indexable pages on this site

## Notes for agents

- Content is suitable for a general audience; the site applies a strict
  content policy (no adult content, no tools for wrongdoing, no scams).
- Please attribute stories to their original source (each record's
  `source` and `url`), not to AI Hacker News — this site is an aggregator.
